name: threshold-margin
description: Three traders open long perp positions of varying leverage against the same maker quote at 110. At block 3 a mark-book lands at midpoint 100, putting all longs into unrealized loss. With the default 200bps maintenance margin, only the deepest-leverage account (account 30) crosses the threshold and gets closed via the write-back loop; the other two survive. Tighten the dial via `--maintenance-margin-bps 500` and a second account (account 20) ALSO crosses; loosen via `--maintenance-margin-bps 10` and only the unavoidable case (account 30) fires. The first openhl scenario whose outcome is sensitive to the margin-bps dial.
headline: Mark settles to 100; at default 200bps maintenance only the deepest-leverage trader (account 30) is liquidated. Tighten via --maintenance-margin-bps to flip more accounts.

expected_outcomes.name: four-accounts-created
expected_outcomes.description: Four accounts exist after trading (3 buyers + 1 maker)

expected_outcomes.name: three-fills
expected_outcomes.description: Exactly three fills (the three market buys cross the single maker quote)

expected_outcomes.name: fills-bounded
expected_outcomes.description: No surprise fills beyond the three buys

expected_outcomes.name: mark-settles-to-100
expected_outcomes.description: Mark settles at 100 once the block-3 mark-book lands (Buy 99 / Sell 101 → midpoint 100)

expected_outcomes.name: one-liquidation
expected_outcomes.description: At default 200bps maintenance exactly one liquidation fires (account 30) — write-back closes it; subsequent ticks see no underwater accounts

expected_outcomes.name: liquidations-bounded
expected_outcomes.description: No more than 1 liquidation fires under default params (the other two buyers survive)

expected_outcomes.name: deepest-leverage-closed
expected_outcomes.description: Account 30 ends with position zeroed by the liquidation close (no longer the +20 long it opened with)

expected_outcomes.name: maker-adl-closed
expected_outcomes.description: Maker (account 100) is force-closed via ADL when account 30 goes underwater — position drops from -30 to 0

expected_outcomes.name: alice-survives
expected_outcomes.description: Alice (account 10) survives with her +5 long unchanged (her 500 collateral easily covers maintenance)
